subject: University Accountability Ordinance
overview: The council held hearings on several utility petitions and debated the proposed university accountability ordinance, voting to refer it to the Committee of the Whole for further refinement. It also approved resolutions concerning parking ticket appeals, street repaving, pop-up community spaces, and short-term rental regulations.

items.title: Hearing 17-043: National Grid Gas Main Installation on Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a grant of location petition from National Grid to install and replace gas mains along Boston Avenue to serve 640 Boston Avenue, with payment provided to the city in lieu of final trench paving.

items.title: Hearing 16-044: National Grid and Verizon Pole Placement on Lambert Street
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid and Verizon to install a new guy stud pole and anchor in the sidewalk at the intersection of Lambert Street and Sheridan Avenue to replace a tree guy fixture.

items.title: Hearing 17-045: National Grid Underground Conduit at Rivers Edge Drive
items.summary: Approved a petition to install approximately 60 feet of conduit at Rivers Edge Drive and Cabot Road to feed a traffic signal, conditioned on work avoiding rush hours or occurring at night.

items.title: Report of Ad Hoc Committee: University Accountability Ordinance
items.summary: Voted to refer the proposed university accountability ordinance back to the Committee of the Whole following debate over public disclosure of student addresses, city enforcement capacity, and mandatory response timeframes.

items.title: Resolution 17-055: Immediate Voiding of Erroneous Park Medford Tickets
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that blatantly mistaken parking citations issued by Park Medford be voided immediately upon demonstration of proof rather than requiring a formal hearing.

items.title: Resolution 17-052: Repaving of Willis Avenue and Governors Avenue
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the mayor to demand that the contractor grind and repave Willis Avenue and Governors Avenue due to deteriorating recent work.

items.title: Resolution 17-053: Pop-Up Community Space Plan
items.summary: Adopted a resolution requesting the administration develop a plan to transform vacant storefronts and lots into temporary community gathering and recreational spaces.

items.title: Resolution 17-054: Salem Street Parcel Historic and Engineering Opinions
items.summary: Approved a request for the Historic District Commission and City Engineer to provide opinions, concerns, and recommendations regarding the potential development of the Salem Street parcel.

items.title: Appointment of City Council Representative to Hormel Stadium Commission
items.summary: Adopted the Committee of the Whole report and voted to appoint attorney Leonard A. Gliona to complete an unexpired term on the Hormel Stadium Commission through February 16, 2019.

items.title: Commendation and Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Congratulated Reverend Noah Evans on his elevation within the Episcopal Church, requested rules regulating Airbnb operations following a nearby fire, and extended condolences on the deaths of Chrissy Fields Cedroni and Kenneth Bascom.

items.title: Community Announcements and Records Approval
items.summary: Councilors commended the Medford Human Rights Commission kickoff, announced an upcoming community police meeting in the Hillside neighborhood, and approved the meeting minutes from January 24, 2017.
